name: Ocean
description: The Ocean Connector gives Claude access to Ocean’s agentic email security platform, enabling AI-powered investigation, explanation, and response to sophisticated social engineering attacks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ocean to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ocean to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ocean.security/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ocean MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ocean provides these MCP tools: get_phishing_report, get_phishing_report_stats, get_threat, get_threat_metrics_summary, list_allow_deny_entries, list_phishing_reports, list_threats, and query_decision_center.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ocean?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Ocean in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Ocean requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ocean is developed by Ocean Security. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
